study_type: retrospective replay; pretrained knowledge is not removed
selection: largest affordable balanced design using qualification cost only; six or three stocks, then two or one trials
train_policy: train and chronological validation labels must mature strictly before the cohort's first decision; no test-driven tuning
uncertainty: paired by case, average trials first, resample cohort blocks; five blocks imply weak inference
privacy: raw evidence private; public notebooks contain derived summaries, coverage, and authenticated drilldowns
